summary: Iteration 7 validates the pairing UX bug fix: 'Associer à ZoneClimate' button + pre-selected default zone. Backend pytest: 50/50 pass (auth, RBAC, installations, pairing/masking, invitations, members). Frontend E2E on a fresh installation (TEST_iter7_pair, installer role): scan-devices-btn visible, POST /discover returns 3 devices, thermostats have zone pre-selected to 'Salon' (first zone), associate button label is exactly 'Associer à ZoneClimate', one-click associate WITHOUT touching the zone selector succeeds (POST /pairing/{pid}/associate → 200) and row disappears. New-zone name flow, gainable flow (no zone selector), and ignore (DELETE /pairing/{pid}) all work. DevicesPanel shows 5 associated devices with CZ- ref QR codes. No product_id ever exposed (verified in iteration 6, unchanged).

issues: Header user badge slightly overlaps the 'Connexion réussie' toast on 1440px viewport — cosmetic, non-blocking
Radix DialogContent still missing aria-describedby on wizard/QR dialogs (warning in console) — carried over from iteration 6

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (aria-describedby) to Dialog components
Optional: expose DELETE /api/installations/{id} + a UI action to clean up accumulated TEST_* installations (7 present under installateur@demo.fr)
critical_code_review_comments: PairingPanel.defaultsFor() uses `zones[0]?.id` as default — good UX but silently overwrites user selection whenever `zones` changes (deps of load callback include zones). Consider guarding to only set when choice[p.id] is undefined; current spread `{...defaultsFor(list), ...prev}` protects existing selections so behavior is safe.
associate_pairing response includes `product_id: null` at top-level device object — safer to strip the key entirely for API consistency (noted iter 6, still present).
PairingPanel imports ICON_OPTIONS/zoneIcons but never renders an icon picker for new zones — dead code (also noted iter 6).
backend_test.py is now ~540 lines; splitting into test_auth/test_pairing/test_installations would improve maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (installer 1-click associate, new-zone associate, gainable associate, ignore, guest read-only all verified)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_iter7_pair installation under installateur@demo.fr with 2 zones (Salon master, Chambre) + 3 pairing associations (thermostat to Salon, thermostat to new 'TEST_NewZone_iter7' zone, gainable). One pairing was ignored. Demo installation 'Maison Client Démo' + 5 demo accounts intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix confirmed: PairingPanel now (a) shows scan-devices-btn prominently, (b) pre-selects first zone for each thermostat, (c) button clearly labelled 'Associer à ZoneClimate' with data-testid=pairing-associate-{uuid}. One-click flow from scan → associate works. Backend endpoints /discover, /pairing/{pid}/associate (zone_id|new_zone_name|as_gainable), DELETE /pairing/{pid} all return 200 for installer/client and 403 for guest. IMPORTANT: use data-testid=tab-devices (not role=tab) to switch tabs. Pairing row testid is 'pairing-{uuid-with-dashes}' — filter with regex /^pairing-[0-9a-f-]{36}$/ to distinguish from child pairing-zone-/pairing-newzone-/pairing-associate-/pairing-ignore- selectors.
verified_features: scan-devices-btn visible for installer on Appareils tab
POST /installations/{iid}/discover returns thermostats + gainable with ref_code, no product_id
For each thermostat, pairing-zone-{id} is pre-populated with the first zone name (Salon)
pairing-associate-{id} button exists per row with exact text 'Associer à ZoneClimate' (heat color, prefix pairing-associate-)
1-click associate on a thermostat with pre-selected zone: POST /associate → 200, row removed, device visible in DevicesPanel with CZ- QR
Typing in pairing-newzone-{id} then clicking associate creates the zone and links device
Gainable pairing: no zone selector, associate button links to master zone (POST → 200)
product_id never present in any /pairing or /devices response
rca of the issue: Original bug: user reported no obvious 'Associate' button, and clicking without a zone selection silently failed. Fix landed in PairingPanel.jsx: (1) defaultsFor() pre-populates choice[pid].zone_id = zones[0].id for every non-gainable pairing at scan/load time, (2) button renamed 'Associer à ZoneClimate' with heat color, (3) each row now has clear data-testid=pairing-associate-{id}. Verified end-to-end: user can click Associer directly after scan without touching any control.
